newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down amid thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down amid thin trading.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday amid thin trading as investors and institutions kept to the sidelines on settlement day and dealers said the sentiment would remain depressed in the near term.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 6.58 points, or 0.47 percent, to end at 1,385.17. Losers led gainers 125-98.

"Trading volume dwindled as investors and institutions were on the fences," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. "Political unrest and a grim economic outlook are dampening factors," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "Hub Power fell 0.70 to 30.50 rupees and Fauji Fertilizer 0.90 to 69. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
